recommendedBaseline: A tactile editorial roast ledger organized around timestamps, provenance, and batch records with restrained spatial transitions.
showcaseDelta: A live rendered Probat-inspired chamber transforms individually animated coffee beans through five materially distinct roast stages.
The visitor's roast-profile choice changes the hero chamber, catalogue emphasis, central roast state, subscription packaging, and route temperature color.

mediaOpportunities.opportunity: Procedural rendered coffee beans and drum machinery based on Northwind's 1962 Probat
mediaOpportunities.rationale: Live geometry makes heat, tumbling, first-crack expansion, development, and drop physically legible without relying on unrelated stock footage.
No Northwind-specific licensed footage was available, and generic footage would weaken the product-specific machine and roast-profile continuity.

prototypeEvidence.boundedApproach: Layered DOM/CSS drum with a finite bean field and staged heat colors
prototypeEvidence.higherCeilingApproach: Live Three.js drum, cast-metal lighting, textured creased beans, independent tumbling, camera depth, and stage-specific motion
prototypeEvidence.builderSelectionRationale: The user selected rendered spatial, then rejected the first dark barrel execution as ugly. The selected prototype was refined into an open front-facing drum with creased beans, visible agitator geometry, restrained cast-metal lighting, and cleaner framing before integration.

prototypeFidelity.focalObject: Individually textured and independently tumbling coffee beans inside an open Probat-inspired drum
prototypeFidelity.copyBalance: Large left-side process language remains readable while the chamber owns the larger right-side field.
prototypeFidelity.controlPlacement: Five roast stages form a full-width instrument rail below the chamber on desktop and a compact touch rail on mobile.
prototypeFidelity.materialLighting: Warm cast metal, dark iron, restrained ember light, and cooling edge light replace the rejected glossy sci-fi barrel.
prototypeFidelity.desktopFraming: Open drum fills the right two-thirds with a readable mechanical rim and visible bean field.
prototypeFidelity.mobileFraming: The drum becomes a cropped in-flow stage below the explanation with labels moved away from the copy.

affectedRegions.effect: Changes the live chamber stage, temperature, profile code, copy, and route accent.
Sets the initial physical roast state before the visitor manipulates the five-stage timeline.
Changes the primary subscription bag label and dispatch-profile code.

mechanisms.name: Profile-controlled chamber entrance
mechanisms.primarySubject: Roast profile material gauge synchronized with the rendered beans and chamber state
mechanisms.experienceRole: Lets the visitor choose the roast trajectory that will propagate through the route.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: Connects a real product preference to spatial material and downstream content.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Writes roastProfile for the catalogue, peak, subscription, and temperature signal.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: The chamber becomes an in-flow rendered viewport with a three-option touch instrument below it.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Recommended would show a timestamped batch record without a live controllable machine.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: The visitor sees the selected roast as a material state rather than only a label.

mechanisms.name: Five-stage physical roast transformation
mechanisms.primarySubject: Thermal development curve synchronized with coffee beans changing through five roast stages
mechanisms.experienceRole: Explains how heat becomes flavor inside Northwind's 1962 Probat.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: Each bean has independent speed, depth wobble, and spin; first crack expands the field and Drop moves the batch downward.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Develops the profile chosen in the hero into a five-state physical process.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: A shorter cropped chamber remains directly controllable by the five-stage touch rail and releases cleanly into the brew guide.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Recommended would use a diagram or editorial sequence rather than rendered per-bean dynamics.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: The animation itself communicates tumbling, expansion, development, and release.

mechanisms.name: Profile-aware subscription packing
mechanisms.primarySubject: The visitor's selected roast bag inside the monthly dispatch crate
mechanisms.experienceRole: Turns the earlier roast choice into a visible recurring-delivery consequence.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: Maintains the connected profile state after the central rendered peak.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Reads roastProfile and prints its label and code on the packed bag.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: The crate and two bags become a compact layered packing composition with touch-safe static emphasis.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Recommended would present a conventional subscription offer without stateful packaging.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: The subscription feels like the completion of the visitor's selected roast journey, and the visitor can cycle the packed profile directly.
